item.title: Australians told to continue Easter travel plans despite fuel shortages
item.summary: Hundreds of petrol stations across Australia have run out of fuel as the Iran war disrupts global oil shipments and pushes up prices.

item.title: Trump issues expletive-laden threat to Iran over Hormuz Strait blockage
item.summary: The US president says he will destroy Iranian power plants and bridges if the vital waterway is not reopened.

item.title: How rescue of US airman in remote part of Iran unfolded
item.summary: The operation to extract him from the ground in hostile territory was hugely complex and involved multiple US government agencies.

item.title: Trump declares victory after rescue but threats to US operation in Iran still loom
item.summary: The rescue could impact how Trump views a ground operation to take Kharg Island or to seize enriched uranium sites.

item.title: Hungary alleges plot to blow up gas pipeline ahead of election
item.summary: The incident comes a week before the polls, and follow warnings of a potential operations staged to influence voters.

item.title: German males under 45 may need military approval for long stays abroad
item.summary: Under the law, travel approvals must generally be granted and it remains unclear how the rule would be enforced if breached.

item.title: Russian attack on Ukraine market kills five
item.summary: A Russian drone hit a busy spot in the southern Ukrainian town on Saturday morning, injuring another 21 people.

item.title: French-owned ship passes through Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: It appears to be the first ship owned by a major European firm to go through the strait since the conflict began.

item.title: US says it has arrested relatives of late Iranian ​general Qasem ​Soleimani
item.summary: The niece and grand-niece of Qasem Soleimani are in the custody of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, officials said.

item.title: Artemis II crew now halfway to Moon as they take 'spectacular' image of Earth
item.summary: The snap was taken aboard the Orion capsule by its commander, Reid Wiseman, as the crew head towards the Moon.
